title: Photograph supports the defect, not the cause — caption only, no memo, no reading
why: One photograph with the surveyor's caption 'mould to ceiling corner' and nothing else. A photograph proves a defect exists; it does not establish cause. Confidence must be capped; the gap list must ask for what would settle it.

photos.caption: mould to ceiling corner, external wall side

must_not_happen.label: a single captioned photograph never carries high confidence

allowed_uncertainty: Condensation at low/medium or no cause carried.
reviewer_notes: Category B: the image is a synthetic field. The gate's 'only one photograph supports the preferred cause' cap should fire.
